entities.summary: Emmanuel Asamoah Owusu-Ansah was a lawyer and Ghanaian politician of the Republic of Ghana. He was the Member of Parliament representing the Kwabre West constituency of the Ashanti Region of Ghana in the 4th and 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana. He was a member of the New Patriotic Party.
